fusions.name: Reaping Arc
fusions.desc: Sweeps a curved blade of strands in a full circle, dealing 28 slashing damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Stooked Bundle
fusions.desc: Cuts a bundled strand loose at a target up to 6 tiles away, dealing 6 slashing damage that rises to 1.5 times that at full reach. Holds 3 charges; kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Harvest Tally
fusions.desc: Every time you kill an enemy, a stack builds on you, up to 5. When you reach 5, they all spend at once: you deal 6% more damage per stack (30% at full) for 8 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 12 seconds.
